welcome to peekers advantage, it's in every game. When you're moving your character, your input is being sent to the server, and then received by other players, so the person swinging the angle first will always see their opponent, before their opponent sees them, because they're getting the updated information before you do(since they're the one moving their character, aka the host of their client)

so what do you do about this? people say swing or be swung for a reason, holding angles when they know where you are will ALWAYS get you killed.
